svg.title: OLSK Large CNC V1 → SmoothieBox exterior connection study
svg.desc: 82 proposed exterior contacts, four SmoothieBox service ports, 52 source positions, 0 source-named wire references, 0 source-named physical attachments, 0 nominal form-inventory positions, 24 dotted function guesses and 28 unrouted positions. All machine connectors are exterior peripherals or explicitly marked source references. No installed wiring is claimed.

svg.text: OLSK Large CNC V1 → SmoothieBox exterior connection study
Proposed exterior terminals → dotted function candidates or explicit OPEN boundaries; no installed harness claim

g.title: G01: explicit design-schematic function guess to OLSK Large CNC V1 design · X external stepper driver position DIR− (DIR− schematic input terminal). FUNCTION GUESS ONLY, not a direct cable or a fitted conductor. Basis: The V1 schematic identifies DIR−/DIR+ as the X driver optocoupled DIR input pair. Pairing the adjacent SmoothieBox single-ended DIR return GND with the negative input is a plausible common-cathode logic arrangement, but it is not specified by the V1 schematic. Interface: Unverified SmoothieBox circuit GND return to the negative side of an external-driver optocoupler input. Do not use protective earth or a motor-power return as a substitute; driver isolation and common-reference requirements are unknown. Checks: Identify the installed external-driver model and confirm its PUL/DIR/ENA input thresholds, current limits, optocoupler topology and polarity.; Measure or obtain the SmoothieBox STEP/DIR/ENABLE output voltage, source/sink current and reference behavior; verify 3.3 V logic can drive the installed optocouplers before connecting.; Confirm this common-cathode pairing is permitted by the driver documentation; do not connect driver VCC to SmoothieBox 5 V without an explicit compatible specification.; Configure X, Y-left, Y-right and Z on X/Y/A/Z banks respectively; set A as the right Y motor, confirm any required direction inversion, and test at low speed with the spindle isolated.; Keep the machine emergency-stop/contactor chain and spindle mains/control circuit independent of these guesses; verify their rated safety operation separately.

G02: explicit design-schematic function guess to OLSK Large CNC V1 design · X external stepper driver position DIR+ (DIR+ schematic input terminal). FUNCTION GUESS ONLY, not a direct cable or a fitted conductor. Basis: The V1 schematic identifies DIR+/DIR− as the X driver optocoupled DIR input pair. Pairing the SmoothieBox single-ended DIR output with the positive input and its adjacent GND with the negative input is a plausible common-cathode logic arrangement, but it is not specified by the V1 schematic. Interface: Unverified single-ended 3.3 V SmoothieBox logic output to the positive side of an external-driver optocoupler input; the paired SmoothieBox GND to the negative side is a guess. Driver current, threshold, polarity, isolation and voltage compatibility are unknown. Checks: Identify the installed external-driver model and confirm its PUL/DIR/ENA input thresholds, current limits, optocoupler topology and polarity.; Measure or obtain the SmoothieBox STEP/DIR/ENABLE output voltage, source/sink current and reference behavior; verify 3.3 V logic can drive the installed optocouplers before connecting.; Confirm this common-cathode pairing is permitted by the driver documentation; do not connect driver VCC to SmoothieBox 5 V without an explicit compatible specification.; Configure X, Y-left, Y-right and Z on X/Y/A/Z banks respectively; set A as the right Y motor, confirm any required direction inversion, and test at low speed with the spindle isolated.; Keep the machine emergency-stop/contactor chain and spindle mains/control circuit independent of these guesses; verify their rated safety operation separately.

svg.text: DOTTED VIOLET = FUNCTION GUESS ONLY. Paths start at the actual drawn exterior screw and end at the named machine contact. No installed continuity or direct cable is established.

OPEN / hollow contact = no SmoothieBox route selected in this study. This does not mean an electrically open circuit, unused pin or NC in the source. Source-empty, unlisted and untranscribed roles remain distinct in their labels.

REFERENCE ONLY = a named source revision, not the installed machine. Reference contacts stay OPEN unless an individually cited dotted function guess is shown. Named hardware with no contact map has an OPEN boundary, not invented '?' pins.

Paths may cross without joining; pale crossing clearance means NO JUNCTION. Multiple guesses from one screw are alternatives unless each shares an explicit FAN-OUT tag. A tagged fan-out still needs separate buffers and load validation. No return bus is inferred.

Exterior label colors: black = circuit GND; red = 3.3 V; orange = 5 V; yellow/gold = load/control feed; blue/violet/green = STEP/DIR/ENABLE. Dotted violet is an evidence state, not a reported cable color. Protective earth is not circuit GND.

DB25, DB44 and 15-contact D-sub housings are outside SmoothieBox. Contact strips preserve source order, not physical pin-row geometry. USB device, USB host, Ethernet and microSD are separate service ports.
RESEARCH DIAGRAM — NOT QUALIFIED FOR PHYSICAL WIRING. Confirm the actual carrier, machine revision, mating view, electrical interface, protection, returns and safety design before construction.
